plugins.name: image-to-html
plugins.description: Reconstruct HTML from a mockup image and objectively gate the render against it (per-region SSIM, edge-XOR, colour sweeps, glyph measurement).

plugins.name: worklog
plugins.description: Per-project, SQLite-backed task & decision log for coding agents, remembered across sessions. MCP server + SessionStart/Stop hooks + /worklog:init. Requires the `worklog` binary on PATH.

plugins.name: mdtohtml
plugins.description: Convert Obsidian-compatible Markdown to styled, self-contained HTML with the mdtohtml CLI. Skill + /mdtohtml:update + auto-update on session start. Requires the `mdtohtml` binary on PATH.
